reviews.author: Emma Turnbull
reviews.text: Went with my sister for lunch the other day. Food was absolutely amazing as always but sadly the service was horrible. Almost every time iv been to this location so far despite it being quite quiet when I go we end up left waiting for service for ages with the shortest being 25 minutes waiting for our bill after they took our plates. This time after they had taken our plates and cups my sister an I were left for a whole hour without a single person coming over to ask for the bill and when we where about to ask someone for the bill they were always shooting past us. I understand being a server is a hard job but leaving a table for an hour while another table was sat beside us given their food and paid within that time is ridiculous. And when we mentioned it while paying all we got was an annoyed look from the staff.

If you love Japanese and Korean food, this is absolutely the perfect place to visit! Highly recommend Maki & Ramen. Definitely one of my favourite places for Asian food! 🥢🇯🇵🇰🇷 And great customer service : everytime active and friendly smile they are.

I found his response disappointing, as he seemed to brush off a genuine safety concern rather than take it seriously.

reviews.author: Harrison Mudge
reviews.text: Went for the first time today. Had the tonkatsu ramen and salmon sushi. Sushi was nice. It had a lightly fried batter outer which gave it a nice crisp crunch and the cooked salmon centre was nice too. Sadly the wasabi on the side that it came with was more sweet than hot. Personally I like my wasabi hot. Then the ramen as my main, all I can really say is it was exceedingly mid. The broth. Was nice, not particularly salty or strong but it was nice. The noodles didn’t really absorb much of the flavour though and the pork while flavourful was a bit tough. To answer the question of would I have if all again, then the answer would be no sadly. I also personally hate when they automatically add a service charge to the bill, forcing you to have to ask to have it removed.

reviews.author: Maya “mayaearth” Earth
reviews.text: I went for dinner there today, food was delicious but the service was quiet bad. I've ordered 2 ramen and 2 side dishes, I've made sure to mention that we would start with the side dishes and then the ramen, specifying to the manager who was taking orders on her pad, the extra beef topping that would go for both. Few minutes later they serve us one ramen. We ask if the second one is coming they say yes. Then the manager comes 5 minutes later, saying we ordered only one ramen, wish I anwser that we ordered two, she ask if we could have this one for now, as it will go soggy. I tell her that I won't be eating the ramen by myself while my partner is watching. She just storms off without a word. When the bill came we noticed that she charged us for three ramen, the other waitress took care of rectifying the bill, we saw that manager coming to her with a smirk to ask what was going on. At the end it got sorted, but we felt that this lady managing, and taking order, needs way more training in customer service, and stop trying to sneakly scam people by adding more to the bill to cover for her own mistake. None of less food was delicious especially the teriyaki chiken, I would've recommended this restaurant, if it wasn't for this women.

reviews.author: Sponge
reviews.text: Service was diabolical, which i dont think was a fault of the junior staff but from poor management. I did note a few individuals who I sussed were management having a bit of an attitude towards their junior staff members. The food came out in staggered stages. People who had arrived some time after us received the whole of their order before ours was complete. The ramen was brought out first, luke warm. Ages later the remainder of our order followed. Our stomachs are playing up today and I believe this to be a fault of food temperatures. Was the kicthen understaffed, who knows. I have been to many ramen restaurants and unfortunately this wasnt great. The toilets were disgusting, clearly not checked throughout the day. Overall, a poor experience, which is a shame really.

reviews.author: Catarina Brazão
reviews.text: Such a cute place, and very nice food!! If you like ramen you will definitely enjoy the food! We aren’t fish people but they had a variety of options for everyone. They were very attentive to allergies as one of us had a fish allergy. Very nice atmosphere, definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Josh McHaffie
reviews.text: Great food and friendly service! Thanks Xuan!

reviews.author: megan birch
reviews.text: First time trying maki and ramen, and infact Japanese food! Very delicious! Staff very welcoming, Very accompanying towards our allergies Thank you so much

reviews.author: Susanna Djurholm
reviews.text: Xuan was amazing! So helpful and patient with us ☺️ such a great server

reviews.author: Meghan Hall
reviews.text: Xuan H was fantastic. Delicious food!

reviews.author: Teodor Zhelyazkov
reviews.text: We visited Maki Ramen today with the family and absolutely loved the service, atmosphere and the delicious food! Special shout out to our fantastic waitress Xuan H. for looking after us! We will definitely rerun again soon!

reviews.author: Evgenia Zaeva
reviews.text: We visited Maki & Ramen and had a fantastic experience! The food was fresh, authentic, and packed with flavor. The homemade noodles and rich broth of the Black Garlic Tonkotsu Ramen were incredible. The service from Xuan H was amazing: fast, friendly, and attentive. Combined with the cozy, modern atmosphere, it made for a great visit. We will definitely be back and highly recommend it to anyone who loves Japanese food!

reviews.author: Louisa Bonney
reviews.text: Great food and really attentive service. Our server Xuan was very friendly and kind and nothing was too much trouble. Thank you for a great lunch!

reviews.author: Charlotte Quenault
reviews.text: Food and service was amazing. Shout out to Xuan who conducted great customer service.

reviews.author: Aiden
reviews.text: Had Xuan H serve us today for lunch. Service and food was absolutely brilliant. Not really a Ramen person but this meal was very nice. xuan H our server was very polite and helpful.

reviews.author: Stephanie Brazao
reviews.text: We had a great time at Maki. The food was really good. We also ordered a creme brûlée (not my favourite). They were very attentive with my fish allergy and the service was really lovely.

reviews.author: Rosie nicholson
reviews.text: Xuan H - best waitress Absolutely fantastic experience at Maki & Ramen! The food was delicious, the atmosphere was lovely and the whole experience was made even better by our waitress Xuan H who was absolutely amazing. So friendly, welcoming, attentive and genuinely went above and beyond to make sure we had a brilliant time. It’s always lovely to receive service that makes you feel so welcome and appreciated. Huge credit to the team, especially our Waitress We will definitely be returning. Highly recommend! ❤️
